## About
Arizona Auto Care is a car repair and maintenance shop on S Kyrene Rd in Tempe. We work on all makes, models and years of vehicles, bumper to bumper, from engine work to transmission installations.
Our mechanics keep up with ongoing training, and we use OEM products whenever possible. We stand behind our work with a warranty on the repairs we do.
Customers give us a 4.6 rating across 116 Google reviews. We're open weekdays and closed on weekends, so give us a call or bring your car by.

## Services
- Wheel alignment: Computerized front-end alignment that sets everything to precise factory specifications.
- Brake repair: Full brake repairs handled by our trained technicians.
- Lube, oil and filters: Routine lube, oil and filter service to keep your car running smoothly.
- A/C and heating: Service for your car's air conditioning and heating.
- Engine and transmission work: We handle engine work and transmission installations on all makes and models.

## FAQ
Q: Do you sell tires?
A: No, we don't sell tires.

Q: Do you do body work?
A: No, we don't do body work. We focus on repair and maintenance.

Q: Is the pre-alignment check free?
A: Yes. If your car pulls to one side or your tires are wearing more than they should, bring it in for a free pre-alignment check.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on all makes, models and years of vehicles.
